source_caption_text:
King Von 🕊️ sister, Kayla, is making sure her brother’s legacy continues to live on in a truly special way, honoring the late rapper with a beautiful custom-made piece of jewelry.

Kayla recently showcased an incredible diamond-encrusted heart pendant featuring a photo of King Von preserved inside. The one-of-a-kind piece is covered in diamonds, with intricate details surrounding the heart-shaped design, making it much more than just an ordinary chain.

The sentimental piece gives Kayla a way to keep her brother close while celebrating the life, memories, and legacy he left behind. Even years after his passing, King Von continues to have an undeniable impact on his family, fans, and the music industry.
